title: WorkerResult
description: Analysis result produced by the platform worker and sent back to the edge. Contains analysis layers, coverage, and confidence data. Edge interface/contracts/schemas/edge/worker_result.v1 vendored kopyasıyla `properties` + `required` düzeyinde EŞDEĞERDİR; bayt-özdeşlik BEKLENMEZ — vendored kopya `additionalProperties: false`, kanonik `unevaluatedProperties: false` idiomunu kullanır (bilinçli ve 9/9 şemada tutarlı; 2026-07-31'de ölçüldü). Doğrulama: tests/test_vendored_parity.py. (Bu, edge-tarafı özet kontratıdır; zengin analiz çıktısı worker/analysis_result.v1'dedir.)

field_id.description: Field identifier for the analyzed area.

crop_type.description: Crop type of the field, e.g. cotton, wheat.

layer_code.description: Analysis layer identifier, e.g. NDVI, NDRE, stress_map.

coverage_ratio.description: Ratio of observed footprint to expected area (KR-065). Range 0-1.

observed_footprint_wkt.description: WKT polygon of the observed analysis coverage footprint.

confidence_score.description: Overall confidence score for the analysis result. Range 0-1.

model_id.description: Identifier of the ML model used for analysis.
